text:
maria: Hey team — Saturn Health asked for a three-part enablement series: intro, integration lab, and live Q&A. I'm proposing regional slots: Tue 10:00 PT / Wed 18:00 CET / Thu 09:00 SGT. Can people confirm which ones they can cover? cc @leo @sasha
leo: Tue 10:00 PT works for me. I can take the runtime & production best-practices section and squeeze in 5 mins on cost optimizations. :thumbsup:
sasha: I can do Tue PT and Thu SGT. I'll build the integration lab (staging -> prod flow) and a troubleshooting checklist.
jordan: Saturn here. Wed 18:00 CET is best for our EMEA engs. Please include migration checklist for saturn-staging -> saturn-prod and a short KMS/data-privacy sign-off for our security team. Also need a Zoom link.
maria: Plan per region: 30m product + 45m hands-on lab + 15m Q&A. Draft agenda:
```
1) 00-05m intro & goals
2) 05-35m architecture + best practices
3) 35-80m hands-on lab (staging -> prod demo)
4) 80-95m Q&A & next steps
```
Suggestions?
leo: Add a 5-min "quick wins" (token/cost tips) right after best practices. Good early ROI.
sasha: Need prework from Saturn: API key, staging access, and one example prompt set. I'll attach lab repo to calendar invite.
jordan: We'll send prework by EOD Mon. Also flagging: renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks. If adoption is slow, they may want to renegotiate.
maria: Good call. I’ll add a week+2 post-workshop 1:1 to review adoption and a renewal health note in the customer record.
calendar-bot: Created event "Saturn Health Enablement - EMEA" for 2025-09-10 18:00 CET. Invitees: maria, leo, sasha, jordan. Link: https://zoom.redwood.example/meet/abc123
maria: Thanks bot. @sasha please attach lab repo and runbook to the invite. I’ll also post a short prework template and survey for feedback.
sasha: Repo: https://git.redwood/saturn-onboard. Runbook will be attached by tomorrow AM.
jordan: Can you include a KMS/data-privacy checklist our security lead can sign off on before prod cutover?
maria: Yes — adding a "Security sign-off" checkbox to prework and calendar notes.
leo: I’ll prepare a 5-slide demo on caching & prefix-KV with perf numbers and a tiny sample config snippet.
maria: Perfect. If no objections I’ll lock the 3 regional slots by EOD and send the prework template + calendar attachments. :rocket:
jordan: Confirmed. Thank you!
leo: :thumbsup:
sasha: :white_check_mark:
maria: Closing loop — invites sent, prework template posted, runbook pinned in the event. I’ll run the post-workshop check-in scheduling after the sessions.
